Installing drawbridge

Install over USB from a computer. No factory reset, and nothing on the phone is erased.

This is still in early alpha testing!!

Installing over USB has been confirmed end to end on a real phone — but on one handset, by the people who built it. Don't use a device you depend on.

Locking drawbridge uninstalls the apps it blocks.

On a phone that is already in use, those apps are removed the moment you lock it, and switching a setting back on afterwards does not bring them back. Nothing else is erased — your photos, messages and other apps stay where they are.

Install over USB

For Google (regular) Android phones and also deGoogled open-source Android devices: install over USB using the flow below.

  1. 1
    Remove every account from the phone — Settings → Passwords, passkeys & accounts. Android only hands over this level of control to a phone with no account on it. You sign back in at step 4.
  2. 2
    Enable Developer Options (tap the build number in Settings → About phone several times) and turn on USB debugging.
  3. 3
    Connect the phone to a computer with a USB cable, and run the installer.
  4. 4
    Sign back in with a Google (or other) account.
Install from your browser

Install drawbridge straight from this site over USB, with no software to set up. Needs Chrome or Edge.

Install over USB

In the meantime it is one command from a copy of the repository — tools/provision-adb.sh — which installs both apps and makes drawbridge the owner of the phone. It is documented in provisioning.md.

After setup

  1. 1
    Move your bookmarks into herald. It installs itself right after drawbridge, so it is already there. Export them from the browser you are leaving, then in herald: ⋮ → Bookmarks → ⋮ → Import. Do this before the next step — activating removes the other browsers, and their bookmarks go with them.
  2. 2
    Open the drawbridge app and activate it.
  3. 3
    Write down the deactivation code shown once — or don't, if you want the protection to stay on for good.

Activating switches USB debugging off. Unlocking drawbridge with your code turns it back on, which is how you would put a later version on the phone over the same cable.

Read the Q&A for what's blocked and why, or see the full sourced breakdown.
